titulo.alumno: Arranging a meeting and confirming the details

intro: In this lesson you will practice arranging a meeting and confirming the details.

texto: Confirm day, time and place; if something changes, communicate the new plan and check that it was understood.

frases.estudio: Ας συναντηθούμε την Παρασκευή στις έξι και ας επιβεβαιώσουμε το μέρος.
frases.alumno: Let's meet on Friday at six and confirm the place.

frases.estudio: Δεν θα προλάβω το λεωφορείο· μπορούμε να συναντηθούμε μισή ώρα αργότερα;
frases.alumno: I won't make it in time for the bus; can we meet half an hour later?

frases.estudio: Το επόμενο Σαββατοκύριακο θα επισκεφτούμε τους φίλους μας στην Πάτρα.
frases.alumno: Next weekend we will visit our friends in Patras.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the message and locate which detail of the plan is confirmed or changed.

pregunta.texto: Write a short two-sentence message in Greek about «Arranging a meeting and confirming the details» and include «επιβεβαιώσουμε».

piezas.explicacion: Check that the message includes a concrete detail, keeps the time or logical order and ends appropriately.
